score_basis: Non-statistical internal evidence-quality score based on 2026 HM Land Registry guidance and current INSPIRE publication, preserving the general-boundaries rule and requiring register/document evidence before inferring ownership rights or constraints.

sources.label: HMLR title plan PG40s5
sources.fact: Updated 13 July 2026; title plan must be viewed with the register and does not by itself resolve every legal boundary detail.

sources.label: HMLR boundaries PG40s3
sources.fact: Updated 1 June 2026; explains general boundaries, legal boundary uncertainty and boundary evidence.

sources.label: HMLR determined boundaries PG40s4
sources.fact: Updated 1 June 2026; distinguishes boundary agreements from determined boundaries.

sources.label: HMLR preparing plans PG40s2
sources.fact: Registration plans depend on source deed/plan quality; the register cannot be made more precise than underlying evidence allows.

sources.label: HMLR search the register
sources.fact: Title plan shows location and general boundaries; official copies are required where proof is needed.

sources.label: HMLR Search for land and property information
sources.fact: Property summary can indicate tenure/restrictive covenants/easements; details require title-register evidence.

sources.label: HMLR search the index map
sources.fact: Index map search can identify title numbers or confirm unregistered land where normal register search is insufficient.

sources.label: HMLR INSPIRE Index Polygons data.gov.uk
sources.fact: Last updated 8 July 2026; open dataset is a subset showing locations of freehold registered property in England and Wales.

sources.label: HMLR INSPIRE July 2026 download
sources.fact: Published 5 July 2026; polygons are indicative extent/position of registered freehold properties and monthly files are provided by local authority.

sources.label: HMLR notices and restrictions PG19
sources.fact: Updated 8 June 2026; notices and restrictions protect/limit interests and dispositions but do not themselves guarantee validity of the underlying interest.

sources.label: HMLR easements PG62
sources.fact: Updated 1 June 2026; registration of legal/equitable/prescriptive easements requires register and instrument context.

sources.label: HMLR mines and minerals PG65
sources.fact: Updated 1 June 2026; mines/minerals may be held separately from the surface and require explicit title evidence.

examples.result: INSPIRE polygon is treated as indicative registered-freehold extent, not a cadastral survey or exact legal boundary.
Title plan is always interpreted with the title register; red edging alone is not ownership-rights proof.
General boundary is not silently converted to a determined boundary.
Restrictive covenant presence requires register/document readback; absence in summary is not a complete legal clearance.
Easement existence/scope is not inferred from access geometry or road adjacency.
Index map/title number identification is a discovery step and not proof of beneficial ownership.
Surface title does not automatically include separately held mines/minerals.
No ownership/legal-right promotion occurs without exact title, register, plan and relevant filed-document evidence.
